Do not fully re-review unchanged child implementations: their reviewed content identities have been proven. Requirement outcome: A child of a Requirement moves from developer handoff to integration in `requirement/BR-N` and on to terminal close through supported lifecycle paths only, including when the requirement branch or main moves during delivery. No step needs a coordinator workaround (manual CI dispatch, a one-time merge of main into the requirement branch, re-pointing a routing record, or a hand-updated retrospective), and every situation the lifecycle cannot handle ends in an explicit blocked state with a reason and the supported next action.
